name: DuoAttention (head-wise retrieval/streaming KV sparsity) - NOT KV quantization
bits: none by default - retrieval heads keep a full KV cache, streaming heads use a lightweight CONSTANT-LENGTH KV cache. The paper's headline long-context result is achieved combined WITH quantization.
activation_scheme: None. Heads are classified into retrieval heads (need full attention over all tokens) and streaming heads (attend to recent tokens and attention sinks only). Only retrieval heads get the full cache; streaming heads get a fixed small cache regardless of context length.
quality_delta: From the abstract: reduces long-context inference memory by up to 2.55x for MHA and 1.67x for GQA, speeds decoding by up to 2.18x (MHA) and 1.50x (GQA), and accelerates pre-filling by up to 1.73x (MHA) and 1.63x (GQA), with minimal accuracy loss. Combined with quantization, it enables LLaMA-3-8B decoding at 3.3 million context length on a single A100 GPU.
notes:
GROUP SIZE NOT APPLICABLE BY CONSTRUCTION: page/head-level selection of which KV to keep or prefetch. No weights are re-gridded. Third boundary record, and the most useful one for planning because it demonstrates the two mechanisms COMPOSE. The 3.3M-token-on-one-A100 figure is explicitly 'combined with quantization' - sparsity alone does not get there. Practical reading: per-head structure means a uniform KV bit width is leaving value on the table, since most heads do not need full history at all. The classification is cheap (optimization-based, synthetic data, no retraining), which is why it is deployable on models whose training data you do not have. SCHEME RECLASSIFIED (parent agent, 2026-10-03): scheme was 'spinquant' (a proxy recorded while the enum lacked a legal value) and is now 'kv-sparsity'. 
NATIVE_SUPPORT CLASSIFIED 2026-10-04: this field is still [] and that is CORRECT, but the empty list used to be ambiguous between three different states and now is not. Reason class on this record: KV-CACHE-ONLY, SO STRUCTURALLY ABSENT. The bits field records that no bits-per-value change: the scheme reduces WHICH positions are retained, fetched or reallocated, so it runs on whatever precision path the accelerator already has for the KV cache. A KV-position policy can never be a hardware format. Consequence for a reader: nothing further to verify - this is a cache-management policy, not a numeric format. The full statement of the three-way distinction, and the worked list of all 72 empty records by class, is in gotcha quant-native-support-empty-means-three-different-things. Rule of thumb for this field everywhere in the repo: if the bits field carries an 'a16', or the scheme is KV-cache-only or a llama.cpp integer storage type, an empty native_support is a DEFINITION and needs no verification; only a W4A4/W8A8/sub-8-bit format with research kernels can have an empty list that is a real finding.
